name: aulalab
description: One link, one live notebook, one AI. Self-hosted workspace for technical seminars.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @aulalab/web && npm run build -w @aulalab/server && npm run build -w @aulalab/runtime
scripts.build:optimized: npm run build:optimized -w @aulalab/web && npm run build -w @aulalab/server && npm run build -w @aulalab/runtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @aulalab/server && npm run typecheck -w @aulalab/web && npm run typecheck -w @aulalab/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @aulalab/cli
scripts.docs:check: python3 docs/build.py && git diff --exit-code -- site/docs site/sitemap.xml
